figures.caption: Figure 1. The a) SEM image, b) TEM image, c) high-resolution TEM (HRTEM) image of the 85Li2S-15CuI materials. d) Fast Fourier transform for (c). e) TEM image and corresponding EDS mappings of S, I, and Cu for 85Li2S-15CuI. f) XRD patterns of (100-x)Li2S-xCuI (x = 5, 10, 15, 20, 25) materials, CuI, and identiﬁed phases for Li2S (PDF# 23–0369). g) Rietveld reﬁnement pattern for 85Li2S-15CuI material. h) The framework structure of Li2S-CuI. i) Raman spectra of (100-x)Li2S-xCuI (x = 0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25) materials and CuI. j) XPS spectra of S 2p, Cu 2p, I 3d, and Li 1s for the 85Li2S-15CuI, Li2S and CuI material.

Figure 2. a) Charge–discharge curves and b) rate capacity of the all-solid-state cells with (100-x)Li2S-xCuI (x = 5, 10, 15, 20). The charge–discharge curves of the all-solid-state cells with 85Li2S-15CuI c) at diﬀerent rates, and diﬀerent cycles at d) 0.2 C and f) 2 C. e) The cycling performance of the all-solid-state cells with 85Li2S-15CuI and 85Li2S-15LiI at 0.2 C. g) The cycling performance of the all-solid-state cells with 85Li2S-15CuI. h) Charge–discharge curves, and i) cycling performance of the all-solid-state cells with diﬀerent active material mass loading at the rate of 0.2 C. j) Comparison of electrochemical performance of the 85Li2S-15CuI cathode with the state-of-the-art ASSLSBs reported in kinds of literature. Cell conﬁgurations, testing conditions, and performance of the selected literature-reported ASSLSBs are listed in Table S7 (Supporting Information).

Figure 3. a) The charge–discharge curves of the all-solid-state cells with 85Li2S-15CuI at 0.05 C. b) Ex situ XRD patterns of 85Li2S-15CuI cathode at diﬀerent states of charge. c–e) XPS spectra of S 2p, Cu 2p, and I 3d for the 85Li2S-15CuI cathode at diﬀerent states of charge.

Figure 4. Cyclic voltammetry proﬁles of ASSLSBs with (100-x)Li2S-xCuI a) x = 0, b) x = 5, c) x = 10, d) x = 15, and e) x = 20 cathode materials cycled at 25 °C in the voltage range of 0.9–2.4 V versus Li─In under a scan rate of 0.1–1 mV s−1. f) The maximum anodic and cathodic peaks, Ip, as a function of the square root of scan rate in (a–e).

Figure 5. a) Minimum energy path for the diﬀusion of Li+ in Li2S, Cu-doped Li2S, I-doped Li2S, Cu, I co-doped Li2S. b) The diagram of crystal structure and Li+ diﬀusion paths in Li2S, Cu-doped Li2S, I-doped Li2S, and Cu, I co-doped Li2S, respectively. The Li, S, Cu, and I atoms are shown in green, orange, turquoise, and purple. The diﬀusion path of Li+ is shown in blue.

Figure 6. a) Schematic of the 85Li2S-15CuI/Si─C all-solid-state full cell. Aluminum and copper foil were used as current collectors for the cathode and anode, respectively. b) Cross-sectional SEM image of the cell, and c) corresponding EDS mapping of Si, C, S, and I. d) Charge–discharge curves and e) rate performance of the 85Li2S-15CuI/Si─C full cell at diﬀerent current densities. f) Cycling performance of the cell at the rate of 0.5 C and 25 °C. g) The initial and second charge–discharge curves of a prototype pouch cell at 0.05 C and 25 °C. h) The safety test of the prototype pouch cell in charge state.
